title: Voice deployment
what: How the testbed deploys the voice: testbed.toml's setup, build and deploy, the voice and studio units and the studio's proxy locations in deploy/.

title: Voice policy values
what: The voice's own policy, policy/voice.toml: a briefing run's cap, the failed notice's kind and the emotions a briefing may carry, served at GET /policy.

title: Voice settings and context
what: The one settings file every binary and script reads (listen, database, data root, unit addresses, studio values) and the context of store and unit clients built from it, in src/settings.rs and src/context.rs.

title: Voice store
what: The voice's own Postgres database: the voices, voice names, voice node list and briefing rows, its migration and the names table's seed from data/ko/voice-names.toml, in src/store/.

title: Clients of other units
what: One temporary client module per sibling the voice calls, gate, receiver, agency, artifact, node, the jake hub, pocket and web, each holding only the voice's calls, in src/units/.
